main_text.p: publice & voce, & scripto proclamata, errores, & crimina non multo ante Romanis inclementer obiecta, impietatisque manifesto modo prehensa, dum vno consensu cum Romanis iungitur, ludi sunt pueriles, & nugamenta, & vt res nullius momenti, adeo inconsiderate posthabentur, vna sola in Patriarchatu restitutione, quia optata contigit, vendidit Photius pietatem, Fidem, Ecclesiam, Christum: quae parentes, & progenitores sanguine, & vita per tot secula redemerunt, sola ambitione Photij turpissimo mercatu prostituuntur. Eant nunc Photiani, & sanctitatem nobis Photij, & sapientiam, & diuinum cultum, & pro Religione certamina, & reliqua, quae in hac Octaua Synodo ad nauseam repetitis clamoribus depraedicantur, insonent. Fides. Catholica infeliciter proscribitur, pietas conculcatur, Christus misere a nouo Iuda diuenditur, & haeresis, & errores profligati, vna cum restitutione Photij in Patriarchatum, in Ecclesiam, in fidelium animos restituuntur. Quamuis ipse Photia-nus non sim, ne[?] in eum inclementior videar, vocem pro eo mittam, & causam suscipiam. page.notes: Catchword "ra" is the start of the next page's word, printed at the lower right. "ne[?]" at the line end before "in eum": the print reads "ne" and may be "nec" with the c lost in the scan. Long s is rendered as plain s throughout. "naufeam" is printed with long s and transcribed as "nauseam". No running head is printed on this page.
